title: AI Consultant
description:
AI Engineer / AI Consultant

Remote UK (with occasional client travel)
Paying between £50,000-£55,000, depending on experience.

We're working with a fast-growing, PE-backed technology group that delivers managed IT, cyber security and AI solutions to SMEs across the UK.

Due to continued growth, they're looking to hire either a hands-on AI Engineer or an AI Consultant with strong technical expertise to join their expanding AI practice.

This is a customer-facing role where you'll help organisations identify AI opportunities, design solutions, and deliver AI-powered assistants, copilots, agents and automations that drive real business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and deploy AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Develop AI assistants, agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
  • Integrate AI tools with business systems and applications via APIs
  • Work directly with clients to understand requirements and deliver solutions
  • Lead workshops, demonstrations and solution discovery sessions
  • Implement testing, monitoring and governance controls
  • Produce technical documentation and support handovers
  • Contribute to the development of reusable AI templates and accelerators


Skills & Experience Required

  • Experience building and deploying AI/LLM solutions
  • Strong Python or C# development skills
  • Experience integrating applications through APIs
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions


Desirable Experience

  • Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry or Azure AI Search
  • Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform
  • Azure DevOps, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines
  • AI evaluation, monitoring and governance frameworks
  • MSP, consultancy or customer-facing technology experience
  • AI-102 or similar certification


Must be eligible to work in the UK
Remote with travel to clients sites in London
Up to 55k, depending on experience.
.
